entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane where everything is made of metal, lit by five suns, one for each color of mana; created by Karn and infected by Phyrexian oil.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem built by Urza who created Mirrodin and unwittingly introduced Phyrexian oil to it.

entities.name: Phyrexian oil
entities.description: A dark contagion Karn unwittingly introduced, which infects the land and breeds horrors.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: The Warden Karn created to protect Mirrodin, who grew unstable, sentient, paranoid and angry, and kidnapped countless beings from other planes.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: The elf who finally defeated Memnarch.

entities.name: The Mirrans
entities.description: The inhabitants of Mirrodin; the first generations vanished and returned to the planes from which they were taken.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: Leader of Phyrexia's red-aligned faction, which turns a blind eye to Mirrodin's citizens and allows them safe harbor.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The source of the horrors emerging from Mirrodin's core, whose factions are not unified in purpose.

events.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin, but something goes wrong and he unwittingly introduces Phyrexian oil.
events.quote: He unwittingly introduced a dark contagion: Phyrexian oil.

events.summary: The Warden Karn created grows unstable and sentient, calling himself Memnarch.
events.quote: Even the Warden that Karn created to protect the plane grew unstable, gaining sentience and calling himself Memnarch.

events.summary: Memnarch kidnaps countless beings from other planes before the elf Glissa Sunseeker defeats him.
events.quote: He kidnapped countless beings from other planes before he was finally defeated by the elf Glissa Sunseeker.

events.summary: New Phyrexian horrors emerge from Mirrodin's core, killing all Mirrans in their path.
events.quote: New Phyrexian horrors continue to emerge from Mirrodin's core, killing all Mirrans in their path

events.summary: Urabrask's red-aligned Phyrexian faction allows Mirrodin's citizens safe harbor.
events.quote: Its red-aligned faction, led by Urabrask, turns a blind eye to the citizens of Mirrodin, allowing them safe harbor.

relations.quote: Long ago, this metal plane was created by Karn, the silver golem built by the Planeswalker Urza.
the silver golem built by the Planeswalker Urza

relations.note: Memnarch was the Warden Karn created.
